objective: Bind project-specific architecture, knowledge, ontology, and tacit context before Kernel work; review and commit verified knowledge after accepted completion; optionally run explicit commit-moonshot Git closeout.
selectedConstraints: Kernel and Relay runtime, state, profile, and project knowledge namespaces must remain isolated.
Raw graph, ontology dump, transcript, runtime log, tool body, and secret-like values must never enter prompt-facing context.
Verified project knowledge writes require accepted Kernel completion and candidate-level evidence.
Knowledge revision updates must be atomic, conflict-aware, and preserve supersession history.
Git commit or push requires explicit request and approval and follows knowledge closeout.
Git closeout evidence cannot create or replace Kernel completion authority.
Account-root project knowledge is excluded from Git staging and preserved on uninstall by default.

knowledge record transition and provenance validation
candidate evidence binding and false-promotion regression
atomic revision crash and concurrency recovery

external_deployment_or_service: optional Git commit/push to configured remote

knowledgeWriteAuthority: accepted completion plus candidate evidence and knowledge commit transaction
